text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval on updates to TO Live's Finance and Information Technology (IT) policies, including the introduction of a new Artificial Intelligence policy.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved updates to Policies 301, 303, 305, 502, 504 and the new Policy 511 (Artificial Intelligence), as outlined in Attachments 1 and 2 to the report ( March 2, 2026) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live.
